newsitem.title: GERMANY: German prosecutors accuse man of Serb war crimes.
newsitem.headline: German prosecutors accuse man of Serb war crimes.

text.p: German prosecutors said on Wednesday they had charged a 56-year-old citizen of the former Yugoslavia with rape, assault and assisting genocide in 1992 while serving with Serb forces in the Bosnian civil war.
The Federal Prosecutor's Office in Karlsruhe said the man, identified only as Maksim S., had twice participated in the rape of a Moslem woman in the Kalesija region of Bosnia.
Prosecutors said the man also led a squad of soldiers which used violence to round up local Moslems and deport them as part of the Bosnian Serbs' policy of "ethnic cleansing".
The suspect removed the eye of one Moslem man with a bayonet during these deportations, prosecutors alleged.
The man, who has lived in Germany since 1969, was detained on Monday in the western state of North-Rhine Westphalia.
